variants.prompt: In a lavish penthouse suite, this captivating woman is draped in a tight, black leather bodysuit that hugs her every contour, the high collar framing her striking emerald eyes and a sultry, inviting gaze. Her raven tresses cascade down her back in soft waves, and she stands poised near an expansive city skyline view, one stiletto heel hooked on a plush couch as she crosses her arms under her ample bust. A diamond choker encircles her elegant neck, drawing attention to her slender throat.
